query:
WITH RECURSIVE identity AS (
          SELECT $1::uuid AS user_id,$2::uuid[] AS groups,$3::bool AS admin,
            $4::uuid[] AS shared_albums,$5::uuid[] AS shared_photos), album_levels AS (
              SELECT a.*, ARRAY[a.id] AS ids, a.slug::text AS path,
                jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'title',a.title,'path',a.slug::text)) AS chain,
                CASE WHEN a.visibility='restricted' THEN ARRAY[a.id] ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[] END AS restricted_ids,
                (a.visibility <> 'restricted' OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM album_grants g WHERE g.album_id=a.id AND
                   ((g.principal_kind='user' AND g.principal_id=i.user_id) OR
                    (g.principal_kind='group' AND g.principal_id=ANY(i.groups))))) IS TRUE AS levels_pass
              FROM albums a CROSS JOIN identity i WHERE a.parent_id IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
              UNION ALL
              SELECT a.*, parent.ids || a.id, parent.path || '/' || a.slug::text,
                parent.chain || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'title',a.title,'path',parent.path || '/' || a.slug::text)),
                parent.restricted_ids || CASE WHEN a.visibility='restricted' THEN ARRAY[a.id] ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[] END,
                parent.levels_pass AND (a.visibility <> 'restricted' OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM album_grants g WHERE g.album_id=a.id AND
                   ((g.principal_kind='user' AND g.principal_id=i.user_id) OR
                    (g.principal_kind='group' AND g.principal_id=ANY(i.groups))))) IS TRUE
              FROM albums a JOIN album_levels parent ON parent.id=a.parent_id CROSS JOIN identity i
              WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT a.id=ANY(parent.ids)
            ), visible_albums AS (
              SELECT a.* FROM album_levels a CROSS JOIN identity i
              WHERE i.admin OR (
                ((i.user_id IS NOT NULL OR (cardinality(i.shared_albums)=0 AND cardinality(i.shared_photos)=0)) AND a.levels_pass)
                OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM unnest(i.shared_albums) target
                  WHERE target=ANY(a.ids) AND a.restricted_ids <@ ARRAY[target]))
            ), visible_photos AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
              SELECT p.*, ARRAY(SELECT target FROM unnest(i.shared_albums) target
                WHERE p.visibility <> 'restricted' AND target=ANY(a.ids) AND a.restricted_ids <@ ARRAY[target]) AS shared_albums,
                (i.admin OR (i.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.levels_pass AND
                (p.visibility <> 'restricted' OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM photo_grants g WHERE g.photo_id=p.id AND
                  ((g.principal_kind='user' AND g.principal_id=i.user_id) OR
                   (g.principal_kind='group' AND g.principal_id=ANY(i.groups))))))) AS account_view
              FROM photos p JOIN album_levels a ON a.id=p.album_id CROSS JOIN identity i
              WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.admin OR (
                (a.levels_pass AND (i.user_id IS NOT NULL OR (cardinality(i.shared_albums)=0 AND cardinality(i.shared_photos)=0)) AND
                  (p.visibility <> 'restricted' OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM photo_grants g WHERE g.photo_id=p.id AND
                     ((g.principal_kind='user' AND g.principal_id=i.user_id) OR
                      (g.principal_kind='group' AND g.principal_id=ANY(i.groups))))))
                OR (p.id=ANY(i.shared_photos) AND cardinality(a.restricted_ids)=0)
                OR (p.visibility <> 'restricted' AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM unnest(i.shared_albums) target
                  WHERE target=ANY(a.ids) AND a.restricted_ids <@ ARRAY[target]))))
            ) , filters AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($6::jsonb) AS f(key text,value text)),
          filtered AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT p.* FROM visible_photos p WHERE p.status='ready'
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM filters f WHERE NOT coalesce(CASE f.key
              WHEN 'camera' THEN lower(concat_ws(' ',nullif(p.camera_make,''),nullif(p.camera_model,'')))=f.value OR lower(p.camera_model)=f.value
              WHEN 'lens' THEN lower(p.lens)=f.value
              WHEN 'tag' THEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM photo_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.id=pt.tag_id WHERE pt.photo_id=p.id AND NOT t.hidden AND (lower(t.name)=f.value OR t.slug::text=f.value))
              WHEN 'place' THEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM places l WHERE l.id=p.place_id AND lower(l.name)=f.value)
              WHEN 'year' THEN extract(year FROM coalesce(p.taken_at,p.posted_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')=f.value::int
              WHEN 'month' THEN extract(month FROM coalesce(p.taken_at,p.posted_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')=f.value::int
              WHEN 'before' THEN coalesce(p.taken_at,p.posted_at)<(f.value::date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
              WHEN 'after' THEN coalesce(p.taken_at,p.posted_at)>=(f.value::date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
              WHEN 'is' THEN CASE f.value WHEN 'hdr' THEN p.is_hdr ELSE p.kind::text=f.value END
              WHEN 'color' THEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM unnest(p.dominant_colors) c WHERE
                abs(((c>>16)&255)-((f.value::int>>16)&255))<=64 AND
                abs(((c>>8)&255)-((f.value::int>>8)&255))<=64 AND abs((c&255)-(f.value::int&255))<=64)
              ELSE false END,false))),
          seed AS (SELECT e.vector,e.model FROM embeddings e JOIN visible_photos p ON p.id=e.photo_id WHERE p.short_id=$9::text),
          query_vector AS (SELECT coalesce($8::text::vector,(SELECT vector FROM seed)) AS v,
            CASE WHEN $8::text IS NOT NULL THEN 'siglip-base-patch16-224@4649052661e53c7000355844105f8a1792088239' ELSE (SELECT model FROM seed) END AS model),
          text_query AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT plainto_tsquery('simple',$7::text) AS q),
          ranked AS (SELECT id,-max(score) AS rank FROM (
          (SELECT title_photo.id,similarity(title_photo.title,$7) AS score FROM photos title_photo
           WHERE $7<>'' AND title_photo.title % $7 AND EXISTS (
             SELECT FROM filtered p WHERE p.id=title_photo.id OFFSET 0)
           ORDER BY title_photo.title <-> $7 LIMIT 200)
          UNION ALL
          (SELECT o.photo_id AS id,ts_rank(o.tsv,(SELECT q FROM text_query)) AS score FROM ocr_text o
           WHERE $7<>'' AND o.tsv @@ (SELECT q FROM text_query) AND EXISTS (
             SELECT FROM filtered p WHERE p.id=o.photo_id OFFSET 0)
           ORDER BY score DESC,o.photo_id LIMIT 200)
          ) matches GROUP BY id ORDER BY rank,id LIMIT 200) SELECT jsonb_build_object('photo',to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object(
            'thumbhash',encode(p.placeholder,'base64'),'derivatives',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'variant',d.variant,'format',d.format,'hdr',d.hdr,'hash',d.hash,'w',d.width,'h',d.height)
              ORDER BY d.width,d.format,d.hdr) FROM derivatives d WHERE d.photo_id=p.id),'[]'::jsonb)),
            'text',left(coalesce((SELECT text FROM ocr_text o WHERE o.photo_id=p.id),''),4096)) AS "payload!"
          FROM ranked r JOIN photos p ON p.id=r.id ORDER BY r.rank,p.id
